services.faq.q1: How do I book my service in Marrakech?
services.faq.a1: To book, simply fill out the form on our home page or click the WhatsApp button to contact us directly. We will check availability and secure your date after a small booking deposit is paid.
services.faq.q2: What are your free travel zones?
services.faq.a2: I travel free of charge throughout Marrakech, including Gueliz, Hivernage, Palmeraie, Route de l'Ourika, and Route de Casablanca. For further travel like the Agafay Desert or the Ourika Mountains, a very modest mileage fee applies.
services.faq.q3: Which cosmetics do you use for the complexion?
services.faq.a3: I work exclusively with high-end makeup from selective major brands: Charlotte Tilbury (Flawless Filter), MAC Cosmetics (Studio Fix), Dior Backstage, Chanel, and Natasha Denona palettes. These products guarantee a natural finish and incomparable resistance to Marrakech's warm climate.
services.faq.q4: Do you offer group rates for guests?
services.faq.a4: Yes, absolutely! For weddings and large events, I offer highly attractive group rates starting from 3 additional guests in addition to the bride. Do not hesitate to mention the number of people to be made up in your booking request to receive a customized quote.
